title: J&K Congress Protests in Srinagar Against Chief Election Commissioner
seoTitle: Srinagar protest against CEC and government

tea.why: Protesting over the SIR row and the treatment of national Congress leaders in Delhi.
tea.want: Demanding the arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the resignation of the Prime Minister and Union Home Minister.
tea.changed: Oct 8: J&K Congress observed a black day and attempted a march, which police and security forces foiled in Srinagar.

summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Congress staged protests in Srinagar against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the SIR row and the treatment of national party leaders in Delhi. Congress leaders and workers assembled at the party headquarters on M.A. Road in Srinagar and attempted to march onto the main road. Carrying placards and shouting slogans against top government officials and the CEC, protesters denounced what they described as an attack on democracy. Police and CRPF personnel intervened, stopping the participants from leaving the party office complex and foiling the demonstrations. Srinagar district president Adil Farooq addressed reporters during the protests, criticizing government actions and demanding accountability.
organizers: Jammu and Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee
demands: Arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Resignation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi
Resignation of Union Home Minister Amit Shah
response: According to sources, police and CRPF personnel stopped the protesters from stepping outside the party office complex and marching onto the main road, thereby foiling the demonstrations.

updates.text: J&K Congress members staged a protest in Srinagar against the CEC over the SIR row, attempting a march that police stopped.
The JKPCC observed a black day and tried to take out a protest march in Srinagar, which police and CRPF forces foiled.
